capabilities: block creation of notes whose name already exists in the vault
block renames and moves into a name that is already taken
restrict guarding to situations where shortest-path links are affected
scope enforcement by file type, defaulting to Markdown
extras: Full documentation (getting started, how it works, settings reference, FAQ) lives in separate linked files not included in the README.
intentEvidence: Keep every note name unique — and stop Obsidian from silently rewriting your links.
motivation: The author built it because automatic link rewrites changed links the user never touched, created noisy git diffs, and made careless undos leave links resolving to the wrong file.
problem: With 'Shortest path when possible' link format, a second note sharing a name makes Obsidian silently rewrite existing wikilinks to full paths, touching notes the user never edited.
summary: Vault guard that blocks creating, renaming, or moving notes whose name would duplicate an existing note, preventing shortest-path link rewrites.
